name: com.innov8tif.okaylite.ocr.OcrCaptureActivity
description: OkayID Lite (Innov8tif OCR SDK) opens the camera to read a Malaysian MyKad. It returns the recognized name, identity number, address and other card details, along with the card image.
disableEffect: The app cannot read or return Malaysian identity-card details through OkayID Lite if this screen is disabled.
